tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active Jobiba vacancies by role or skill keywords, location, work mode, employment type, experience level and salary range (a salary range needs a currency and pay period). Returns job cards with title, company, location, published pay, skills, a description excerpt and URLs, with paging.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve one active Jobiba vacancy by jobId or slug: sanitized full description, published salary, skills, location and canonical URL. Inactive or expired postings are not returned.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Read the authenticated candidate profile using only career facts needed for job workflows.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Change fields the user asked to change. Every value is validated (phone, https links, work preference Remote/Hybrid/On-site, visibility). A list you send may only add entries: if it leaves out entries already on the profile nothing is saved, unless replaceLists is true because the user asked to repl

tools.name: list_my_resumes
tools.description: List resumes owned by the authenticated candidate.

tools.name: build_or_refine_resume
tools.description: Create or refine a saved Jobiba resume using verified profile facts and optional job context.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Apply to a job with a chosen resume. For Jobiba-native jobs the first call returns a preview and sends nothing; the application is submitted, with the resume attached as a PDF snapshot, only when called again with confirm=true. For jobs that use an external employer form it returns Jobiba's apply li

tools.name: list_my_applications
tools.description: Read the authenticated candidate application tracker.

tools.name: skill_gap_analysis
tools.description: Compare a public Jobiba job skills list with the candidate profile.

tools.name: interview_prep
tools.description: Generate role-specific interview preparation without inventing candidate facts.

tools.name: generate_cover_letter
tools.description: Generate a truthful job-specific cover letter for review.

tools.name: job_match_score
tools.description: Scores the signed-in candidate's profile against an active Jobiba job using only profile and job facts, returning an indicative score, evidence confidence, matched skills, missing evidence and next actions. It is not a hiring prediction.

tools.name: application_readiness
tools.description: Check whether the selected active Jobiba vacancy is ready to apply to, using the authenticated candidate's profile and an owned resume. Return the exact missing prerequisites and external-application handoff status.

tools.name: prepare_complete_application
tools.description: Builds a reviewable application package for an active vacancy: evidence-based match, readiness gaps, a tailored saved resume (with keyword coverage and a change list) and a cover-letter draft. It does not submit anything or contact any employer.

tools.name: profile_optimizer
tools.description: Analyze the candidate profile for missing, weak or inconsistent career information and return prioritized improvements without fabricating facts.

tools.name: career_path
tools.description: Create a practical career path from verified candidate experience, education and skills.

tools.name: salary_analysis
tools.description: Basic salary range from matching active Jobiba jobs. salary_research returns a fuller view (percentiles, trend, experience curve, skill premiums, cities). Not financial advice.

tools.name: ai_provider_status
tools.description: Inspect configured chat and embedding provider readiness without exposing provider credentials or endpoints.

tools.name: mock_interview
tools.description: Generate a role-specific mock interview plan and questions using verified candidate facts.

tools.name: salary_research
tools.description: Salary research for a role from published Jobiba salaries: market percentiles (p10-p90) with sample size and confidence, 3-year trend, pay by experience level, skills associated with higher pay, best-paying cities, live jobs that publish pay, and plain-language observations. Returns an explicit no-d

tools.name: analyze_offer
tools.description: Compare a job offer with the market and get negotiation advice. Accepts either an amount (+currency, +period) or pasted offer-letter text. Says where the offer sits (percentile), what components matter, India in-hand estimate for INR, and what to negotiate. Needs a role.

tools.name: salary_calculator
tools.description: India pay calculators. mode 'ctc_to_in_hand' (needs annualCtc in INR) estimates monthly take-home with PF, gratuity and tax. mode 'hike' (needs currentSalary plus newSalary or hikePercent) shows the raise, real raise after inflation.

tools.name: company_insights
tools.description: Company research from Jobiba data: profile, verified status, open jobs, anonymous moderated employee reviews (ratings, would-recommend), interview difficulty and published pay by role.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save an active job to the candidate's Jobiba saved list.

tools.name: unsave_job
tools.description: Remove a job from the saved list.

tools.name: list_saved_jobs
tools.description: List the candidate's saved jobs and whether each is still open.

tools.name: create_job_alert
tools.description: Creates a daily or weekly email alert for new matching jobs, sent to the candidate's Jobiba account address. Limit of 10 active alerts. Answers how many live jobs added in the last 7 days match it now and up to 3 of them (title, company, place, URL).

tools.name: list_job_alerts
tools.description: List the candidate's active job alerts.

tools.name: delete_job_alert
tools.description: Turn off one alert by alertId.

tools.name: update_job_alert
tools.description: Change one of the user's own job alerts by alertId: pause or resume it, daily or weekly, its location, and its filters (work mode, job type, level, minimum annual pay + currency). tools.description: Creates a new saved CV optimised for one job: the summary and experience bullets are reworded in the job's language without adding employers, titles, dates, tools, skills or numbers that are not already in the CV, and relevant skills move first. tools.description: Scores the candidate profile out of 100 across 13 sections, lists the next improvements with points to gain, and reports whether recruiters can currently find the profile.

tools.description: Reads the CV file the user already uploaded to their Jobiba profile and fills the profile from it with the same rules as import_cv_text. Without apply=true it returns a preview only. If no CV file is on the profile it says so and points to the profile page.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ai_provider_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Inspect configured chat and embedding provider readiness without exposing provider credentials or endpoints.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "jobs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, update_my_profile, company_insights, import_profile_from_cv · Private data: apply_to_job, prepare_complete_application, ai_provider_status, import_my_uploaded_cv · Public sink: update_my_profile, prepare_complete_application, salary_research, create_job_alert, update_job_alert, import_profile_from_cv · Destructive: unsave_job, delete_job_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, update_my_profile, company_insights, import_profile_from_cv · Private data: apply_to_job, prepare_complete_application, ai_provider_status, import_my_uploaded_cv · Public sink: update_my_profile, prepare_complete_application, salary_research, create_job_alert, update_job_alert, import_profile_from_cv · Destructive: unsave_job, delete_job_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "apply_to_job" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
